title: Bartell dArcy too that he used to make fun of when he commenced kissing me on the choir stairs
html_source:
We learn that Bartell d'Arcy (a tenor) kissed Molly on the choir stairs, after she sang a hymn.

We have also met d'Arcy in Chapter 8–

Bartell d'Arcy was the tenor, just coming out then. Seeing her home after practice. Conceited fellow with his waxedup moustache. Gave her that song Winds that blow from the south.

–as well as Joyce’s story “The Dead,” from Dubliners.
